# Journal-supplied external files

The following workbooks are intentionally not stored in this public GitHub
repository. They are supplied separately to the journal:

- `Supplementary_Data.xlsx`, required for Figures 4, 5, and 7;
- `Granulo_laser_30.xlsx`, required for Figure 6.

To regenerate these figures, place local copies here using the exact filenames
shown above. Git ignores all other files in this directory.
